items.title: Build workflows before collecting tools
items.summary: Start with one repeated job, then design the smallest reliable process around it.

items.title: Clarity is part of premium design
items.summary: A buyer should understand what a product is, who it is for and what is included within seconds.

items.title: Reduce friction before adding systems
items.summary: Small changes in how things are stored, planned or started can be more useful than a complex setup.
